description: The **Equipment Coordinator** manages GNGRLL's playing equipment inventory and purchasing across the year: bats, baseballs/softballs, catcher's gear, helmets, tees, nets, and the field gear bins, along with storage security. Key responsibilities include the fall and pre-season equipment inventories, purchasing replacement and season-prep gear within board-approved spending caps (e.g. up to $5,000/season, bats not to exceed $2,000, balls $1,400-$2,500, helmets up to $2,000), setting up Tee Ball/Coach Pitch field bins, and recruiting volunteers to assemble gear bins. At end of season the coordinator leads gear collection, sorting, and storage (gear bags/bins, batting cage nets) and the concessions/upstairs cleanout.

calendar.description: Identify and order bat/ball/team equipment replacements for next season within approved caps (bats not to exceed $2,000; balls $1,400-$2,500).

calendar.description: Complete the fall equipment inventory to establish what is on hand and what must be replaced before the coming season.
